concerns.text: Task T005d (exclusion logging) depends on T013d (SD calculation) and T013b (scrubbing), but T013d is defined as a sub-task of T013b. The dependency chain T013b -> T013d -> T005d is valid, but T005d is listed as depending on T013d which is a sub-task of T013b. However, T013d is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) but it produces an artifact (subject_sd_values.csv) required by T014 and T015a. The ordering is technically correct, but the task T005d description says 'This task MUST run AFTER scrubbing (T013b) and SD calculation (T013d) but BEFORE truncation (T014)'. T014 depends on T013d and T005d. This creates a valid chain. However, T005d is marked [P] but it reads from T013d's output and writes to exclusions.log. If T013d is parallel, T005d must wait for it. The [P] tag on T005d is misleading if it implies it can run in parallel with T013d. It should be [P] only if it can run in parallel with other exclusion checks, but it depends on T013d. The real issue is T013d is a sub-task of T013b, but T005d depends on T013d. This is a semantic dependency violation: T005d depends on a sub-task of T013b, but T013b is the parent. The dependency should be on T013b or the sub-task should be a top-level task. More critically, T005d is marked [P] but it has a hard dependency on T013d. If T013d is parallel, T005d can run after it, but the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with T013d, which is false. This is a [P] correctness violation.

Task T015a (entropy calculation) depends on T014 (truncation) and T013d (SD calculation). T014 depends on T013d and T005d. T005d depends on T013d and T013b. The chain is T013b -> T013d -> T005d -> T014 -> T015a. This is correct. However, T015a is marked [P] but it depends on T014 and T013d. If T014 is parallel, T015a can run after it, but the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with T014, which is false. This is a [P] correctness violation. Additionally, T015a requires the SD from T013d, which is computed on post-scrubbing, pre-truncation data. T014 truncates the data. T015a uses the truncated data for entropy but the SD from T013d. This is correct per FR-010. The ordering is correct, but the [P] tag is wrong.

Task T023a (PCA reduction) depends on T022a (connectivity matrix). T022a depends on T014 (truncation). The chain is T014 -> T022a -> T023a. This is correct. However, T023a is marked [P] but it depends on T022a. If T022a is parallel, T023a can run after it, but the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with T022a, which is false. This is a [P] correctness violation. Additionally, T023a reduces the 200x200 matrix to 200 components, which is correct per FR-008. The ordering is correct, but the [P] tag is wrong.

Task T024a (Entropy-only model) depends on T018 (entropy features) and T023b (connectivity baseline). T018 depends on T015d (imputation), which depends on T015c (cohort median), which depends on T015a (entropy calculation). T015a depends on T014 and T013d. T023b depends on T023a (PCA), which depends on T022a (connectivity matrix), which depends on T014. The chain is T014 -> T015a -> T015c -> T015d -> T018 -> T024a and T014 -> T022a -> T023a -> T023b -> T024a. This is correct. However, T024a is marked [P] but it depends on T018 and T023b. If T018 and T023b are parallel, T024a can run after them, but the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with them, which is false. This is a [P] correctness violation.

Task T038a (aggregate validation metrics) depends on T036a, T036b, T037, T032b, T033, T034, T035. T036a depends on T027, T024a, T023b. T027 depends on T026 (CV), which depends on T025 (Logistic Ridge), which depends on T024a, T024b, T024c. T024a depends on T018 and T023b. T023b depends on T023a, which depends on T022a, which depends on T014. T032b depends on T032a (permutations), which depends on T024a. T033 depends on T024a. T034 depends on T024a. T035 depends on T013c and T015d. T013c depends on T013b, which depends on T005a. T015d depends on T015c, which depends on T015a, which depends on T014 and T013d. The chain is complex but valid. However, T038a is marked [P] but it depends on multiple tasks. If those tasks are parallel, T038a can run after them, but the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with them, which is false. This is a [P] correctness violation.

Task T061 (streaming data loading) is in Phase 7 (Revision) but it is a foundational task that should be in Phase 2 (Foundational). It depends on T005a (fetch dataset) and T005b (checksums). T005a and T005b are in Phase 2. T061 should be before T005a or integrated into T005a. Placing it in Phase 7 violates the 'foundational tasks first' principle. This is a hard ordering violation.

Task T062 (sample size justification) is in Phase 7 but it is a configuration task that should be in Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 1 (Setup). It defines SAMPLE_SIZE_N in config.py, which is used by T004 (hyperparameters). T004 is in Phase 2. T062 should be before T004 or integrated into T004. Placing it in Phase 7 violates the 'foundational tasks first' principle. This is a hard ordering violation.

Task T063 (deterministic seeding for permutation tests) is in Phase 7 but it is a foundational task that should be in Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 5 (US3 implementation). It sets np.random.seed(42) in code/validation.py, which is used by T032a (permutations). T032a is in Phase 5. T063 should be before T032a or integrated into T032a. Placing it in Phase 7 violates the 'foundational tasks first' principle. This is a hard ordering violation.

Task T064 (data provenance check) is in Phase 7 but it is a foundational task that should be in Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 1 (Setup). It verifies checksums in code/main.py, which is used by T018 (orchestrator). T018 is in Phase 3. T064 should be before T018 or integrated into T018. Placing it in Phase 7 violates the 'foundational tasks first' principle. This is a hard ordering violation.

Task T065 (motion confound unit test) is in Phase 7 but it is a test task that should be in Phase 3 (US1 tests) or Phase 5 (US3 tests). It tests code/validation.py, which is used by T035 (motion confound check). T035 is in Phase 5. T065 should be before T035 or integrated into T035. Placing it in Phase 7 violates the 'foundational tasks first' principle. This is a hard ordering violation.
